content:
emma (People Ops): Quick heads up — little change to this cycle's review form routing. please scan.

lisa (People Ops): what changed?

emma (People Ops): We're adding an optional 'route to helpdesk' checkbox on the manager review form so ops can triage calibration anomalies or missing reviewer flows.

maria (People Ops - PM): The intention is that managers can flag when they need HR help (conflicts, missing feedback, or form attachment issues). Flags will create a ticket for ppl-ops.

raj (Manager - Platform): Is this automatic or do we write a note?

emma (People Ops): You can add a short note — recommended. If checked + note provided, it auto-queues a ticket. If checked w/o note, it opens a ticket with form metadata and default message.

matt (Eng Manager): Any changes to deadlines because of this?

lisa (People Ops): No change to the overall timeline. But any manager-requested helpdesk ticket will get a soft SLA: 3 business days triage. We'll prioritize calibration window blockers.

emma (People Ops): Form link: https://redwood.app/forms/review-v2?id=FR-2026-03  — form_id: `FR-2026-03`. If you want to test, open and toggle the "route to helpdesk" checkbox at the bottom.

raj (Manager - Platform): Cool. Will this create a message in #ppl-ops or create a ticket in Zendesk?

maria (People Ops - PM): It creates a Zendesk ticket (tagged `perf-review` + team tag from the manager). We'll post a summary to #ppl-ops for visibility only, not for tracking.

emma (People Ops): calendar-bot will still send the manager reminders 2 days before the manager deadline. Reminder unchanged.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Manager review deadline — Apr 02 09:00 UTC. (Reminder will send Apr 01 09:00 UTC)

matt (Eng Manager): One request: can we include the list of missing reviewers in the auto-ticket body? saves a back-and-forth.

emma (People Ops): yes — ticket includes: manager name, team, missing reviewer list (if any), form_id and link, and the free-text note.

raj (Manager - Platform): perfect. thanks. i'll run this by the leads during sync and ask them to use the checkbox for any calibration unknowns.

lisa (People Ops): thanks all — ping me or @maria if you see anything weird during the first wave. :raised_hands:
